name: Textio
summary: Writing guidance for recruiting and performance management, including job posts and reviews.
description: Textio helps recruiting and HR teams write job posts and helps managers write performance reviews and feedback that is growth-oriented and free of biased language. It also provides interview intelligence. A free trial account can be created, and paid packages are designed with sales; no public prices are listed. Its products are Textio Feedback, Textio Recruiting and Lavalier Interview Intelligence.

howToUse.title: Open Textio
howToUse.description: Open Textio and create a trial account, or request a demo. Paid packages are designed with sales, and no public prices are listed.

howToUse.title: Write a job post
howToUse.description: In Textio Recruiting, write job posts and remove biased language.

howToUse.title: Use interview intelligence
howToUse.description: Open Lavalier Interview Intelligence, align the interview with the role, and document interview feedback.

howToUse.title: Write growth-oriented feedback
howToUse.description: In Textio Feedback, managers write performance reviews and other feedback that stays growth-oriented.
